svg.title: GH1-E-01 Power distribution and 24 V DC

g.text: -W1 5G10 mm², supply from farm LV board
• Rated supply 3/N/PE AC 400/230 V ±10 %, 50 Hz, TN-S. Phase rotation L1-L2-L3 clockwise (check at -X1).
• -Q0: 4-pole switch-disconnector 40 A, red/yellow door handle, lockable in OFF (LOTO). -X1:1...4 stay live with -Q0 open: shrouded, warning label.
• Prospective short-circuit current at -X1 to be confirmed by site; assembly SCCR >= PSCC (IEC 61439-1).
• Outdoor and wet-area circuits (dosing pumps, analysers) on 30 mA RCD protection; motors fed by MPCBs, fault protection by automatic disconnection (IEC 60364-4-41).
-> DO supply groups -A1.3 and -A1.4 group A /E-08.1
Coils and solenoids lose power on E-stop, independently
-X0 0V-PE bond (PELV), removable link for insulation test
single bonding point; 24 V circuits earthed here only
Irrigation, fertigation and climate control, 1 000 m² greenhouse
OpenPLC Runtime v4 + Modbus TCP remote I/O
Electrical drawing set - control panel GH-1 (pump room)
